lines.zh: 我停在远处，慢慢走两步。
lines.en: I stop far off and take two slow steps.
I take a step and retreat.
I circle the house.

lines.zh: 我在你看得见的地方走动。
lines.en: I walk where you can see me.
I walk to the window and stand a while.

lines.zh: 我的步子很轻，几乎听不见。
lines.en: My steps are light, almost inaudible.

lines.zh: 我从树后面慢慢挪出来。
lines.en: I drift out from behind the tree.
I walk while never taking my eyes off you.

lines.zh: 我与你保持四格的距离。
lines.en: I keep four blocks between us.
I walk into the road and wait.
I come no closer and do not go far.
Even turning away, I watch you.
I watch you from a distance.
I stand still, my hair hanging down.
I wait for you to take one step closer.
My hands hang at my sides.
I neither beckon nor leave.
I count how many blocks you have walked.

lines.zh: 我不出声，等你自己过来。
lines.en: I stay silent and let you come.
This place is mine to watch.
I blink, slowly.
I am waiting for a foolish person.
Birds fly off in the distance.
I stand, my posture unchanged.
Don't come closer; stay there.
I stand far off and do not move.
One more step and I chase you down.
You should not have turned this way.
I have been counting your steps.
Do you like being watched?

lines.zh: 我看着你，你就不会走神。
lines.en: While I watch, you will not lose focus.
I can see the sweat on you.
I do not move until you do.
You have slowed your steps.
I know the way you walk.
You are counting the steps you need.
Behind you the road is just the same.
I stand at the far edge of your sight.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸告诉我，你在怕。
lines.en: Your breathing tells me you are afraid.
You smile, but your legs have not moved.
Back away; I will not follow.
You touched me, and I retreat.
I am not often struck.
That changed my expression.
I back two blocks, still watching you.
I will not show you blood.

lines.zh: 你动手之前想清楚了吗。
lines.en: Did you think before you struck?

lines.zh: 我把头发拢到耳后站直。
lines.en: I tuck my hair back and stand straight.
You have displeased me.
I look better from a distance.
Now it is my turn.
Do not raise what is in your hand.
I stare at it, but I do not come.
Hold it up and I will watch.
I drift a little toward you.
Do not drop it.
This distance is not close enough.

lines.zh: 你把它留在原地，我就取。
lines.en: Leave it there and I will take it.

lines.zh: 我低头看了一眼，就抬起来。
lines.en: I glance down once, then look up.
Keep holding it and I keep standing.
That distance was already too close.
That contact was your mistake.
I raise my eyes and look straight at you.
My hair brushes your hand.
You back off half a step; too late.

lines.zh: 我什么也没说，只是转身。
lines.en: I say nothing and simply turn.
You hit me, not the door.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离消失了。
lines.en: The distance between us is gone.
You have messed up my hair.
Now I will chase you down.
I only watch; I do not come near.
That question crosses a line.
I do not need anyone to come.
I tilt my head and turn away.

lines.zh: 你在这种时候还想这个。
lines.en: You think of that at a time like this.
The me in the distance does not answer.
I step back two blocks.
Ask again and I leave.
I belong to no one place.
That subject ends here.
I bend slowly and pick it up.

lines.zh: 我拿在手里，还是看着你。
lines.en: I hold it up while still watching you.
It fell between us; it is mine.
I hold it between my fingertips.
I do not pocket it; I hold it up.
You saw that, didn't you.
It carries your scent.
I set it down in a new place.
To take it back, you must come closer.
You have come over.

lines.zh: 我等你到这一步很久了。
lines.en: I waited a long time for this step.
I have you; don't look back.
You have entered my distance.

lines.zh: 我抬头，头发遮住半边脸。
lines.en: I lift my head, hair over half my face.
You hesitated just now.
There is no other way here.
I begin to close in, step by step.
You look at me; I do not look away.
Your feet are backing away.
I need not run; walking will do.
You have provoked me.
From here to there is not far.
I know which block you stand on.
Now, do not think of leaving.
You run; I still walk.

lines.zh: 我穿过草丛，衣角挂着露水。
lines.en: I cross the grass, dew on my hem.
I know you stopped at the corner.
I do not shout; shouting would be polite.

lines.zh: 你越跑越远，可路是圆的。
lines.en: You run far, but the road is round.
You pant behind the door; I count.
You dare not even turn your head.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙，一直与你平行。
lines.en: I move along the wall, parallel to you.
Your footsteps are trembling.

lines.zh: 我把距离从四格缩到三格。
lines.en: I close the gap from four blocks to three.

lines.zh: 你跑进了没有出口的院子。
lines.en: You ran into a yard with no way out.
You stop, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我抬手，把头发拢到耳后。
lines.en: I lift a hand and tuck my hair behind my ear.
You look up, and our eyes meet.
One more step and you are before me.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，一点也不急。
lines.en: I walk steadily, in no hurry.
The end of this road is me.
I catch your wrist in my hand.
When I strike, not even the wind sounds.
I come close, right up to you.
You pull back; I still follow.
My nails are long.

lines.zh: 你挡住了眼睛，露出喉咙。
lines.en: You cover your eyes and leave your throat.
I hook my fingers in your collar.
You strike back and I lean aside.
I neither cry out nor smile.

lines.zh: 你的手在我手指下松了。
lines.en: Your hand loosens under my fingers.
I take one more step forward.
I crouch to your height.
I tilt my head aside from your fist.
If you stay still, so will I.
You moved; do not blame me.

lines.zh: 我出现在你看得见的远处。
lines.en: I appear at a distance you can see.
I simply stand there and do not move.
You have not noticed me yet.
The wind moves my hem.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把头发拨到一边。
lines.en: I slowly push my hair aside.
This place is quiet; good for watching.

lines.zh: 我和你的距离，正好四格。
lines.en: The distance between us is exactly four blocks.
The light falls on me without warmth.
I do not come closer.
I wait for you to notice me first.
A figure has settled in the distance.
I bow my head as though waiting.

lines.zh: 你要是不理我，我就走了。
lines.en: Ignore me and I will leave.
I have stood on this road many times.
The lamp is lit, and I am outside the window.
I am waiting for your decision.
Sooner or later you will come this way.

lines.zh: 火光照在我脸上，很难看。
lines.en: The firelight on my face is ugly.
I fall, my hem flaring.
Water fills my throat; it is unpleasant.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的头发吹乱了。
lines.en: The blast blows my hair loose.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的肩，划开衣料。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my shoulder and tears the cloth.
That light forces my eyes shut.
I grow thinner, and still I stand.

lines.zh: 雷光把这一带照得发白。
lines.en: The lightning bleaches the whole area.

lines.zh: 我落进空处，眼睛还睁着。
lines.en: I fall into nothing, eyes still open.
